title: Why Russia Is Erasing Stalin’s Crimes
summary_full: Across Russia, memorials to victims of Joseph Stalin’s repressive regime are being quietly dismantled as more and more critics of the war in Ukraine are jailed. Our Moscow correspondent Valerie Hopkins takes us to one example of this erasure.
